pages.text: Press $(k:justlevelingfork.open_aptitudes) to open your aptitude tree. $(thing)Iridescent Aptitudes$() is the pack's RPG leveling layer.$(br2)Each of the eight aptitudes (STR, CON, DEX, DEF, MAG, INT, BLD, LCK) gains XP from the gameplay actions that match its theme, and unlocks skills and passives at set levels.

pages.title: Eight Aptitudes
pages.text: $(bold)STR$() Strength: melee damage, physical might$(br)$(bold)CON$() Constitution: HP, hunger, environment$(br)$(bold)DEX$() Dexterity: speed, agility, ranged$(br)$(bold)DEF$() Defense: armor, mitigation, knockback$(br)$(bold)MAG$() Magic: spell power, mana, magic offense$(br)$(bold)INT$() Intelligence: XP gain, knowledge, refunds$(br)$(bold)BLD$() Building: mining, reach, crafting refunds$(br)$(bold)LCK$() Luck: drop rates, jackpot procs

pages.title: Five-Tier Skills
pages.text: Each aptitude has $(bold)5$() skill nodes, at levels $(bold)5 / 10 / 15 / 20 / 30$(), and each one opens a new ability. The level 30 node is the aptitude's capstone.$(br2)Hover a node in the aptitude screen to see its exact effect.

pages.title: Always-On Passives
pages.text: Some aptitudes also have passives that scale with level, without buying a node:$(br2)$(bold)MAG$(): Spell Power (up to +16% spell damage at level 32) and Mana Regen (up to +32%)$(br)$(bold)INT$(): Attack Speed, and Critical Chance (up to +25% at level 32, for melee, ranged and magic)$(br)$(bold)LCK$(): Luck (up to +2) and Critical Damage (up to +25%)$(br2)$(bold)Next: press $(k:justlevelingfork.open_aptitudes) and spend your banked points.$()
